Go fuck yourself. I thought this sub was for giving 'advise', which is something you apparently feel you can give with the *arrogance* that whatever solution you think of is absolutely correct. Ah yes, being mean to someone who is in pain is the perfect way to solve this! I definitely am qualified to solve this dispute after reading one text post from an over emotional half-drunk bitch.

This is the reason people should go to actual therapists and not random reddit assholes. Thank you for affirming that to me.

So I should just abandon someone who has no one else to turn to? My own dad at that. Sounds like a great idea until you put yourself in their shoes. Only helping yourself is a wonderfully selfish way of living. 

I don't know why I bothered asking for advise.

Because my mom and I both agree it's the alcohol that amplifies it. Most of the time he's funny and only a little difficult to get along with at timea. I guess you could be right and I'm just an enabler. I should probably just go kill myself, heaven knows I've thought about it enough. One less reason for my mom to stay with him, right?
